experiment_scope.interpretation: A paired comparison requires the same cohort, decoding, prompt/schema/pipeline and product-source hashes; it does not establish production or traffic performance.

limitations: Synthetic diagnostic product cohort; it is not human-authored data, traffic, a blind holdout or a model comparison.
Only literal non-membership against public v2 dev utterances is checked for unseen paraphrases; it does not prove linguistic independence.
The cohort has no theta-based utility claim. Recommendation checks use independently written spoken constraints and catalog membership.
The frozen cohort is reused as a fixed fixture for this controlled comparison; it is not a new independent model-evaluation split.
